Programming Language Reference: Kotlin
Version: Kotlin 1.9 / 2.0 (K2 compiler)
Syntax: Concise multiplatform language targeting JVM, Android, JavaScript, and Native (LLVM).
Semantics: First-class null safety in type system, extension functions, smart casts, coroutines for structured concurrency.
Type System: Static typing with distinct nullable (T?) and non-nullable (T) types, sealed classes/interfaces, reified generics.
Memory Model: Managed garbage collection on JVM, ARC on Kotlin/Native, full Java interop without overhead.
Concurrency: Kotlin Coroutines: suspend functions, Dispatchers, Flow (reactive streams), structured concurrency scopes.
Error Handling: Unchecked exceptions, Result functional handling, runCatching block.
Standard APIs: kotlin.collections, kotlin.sequences, kotlinx.coroutines, kotlinx.serialization
Specification: Kotlin Language Specification (JetBrains)
Official Docs: https://kotlinlang.org/docs/
